15		BuildTime = ""
16		GitCommit = ""
17	)

19	func main() {
20		version := effectiveVersion(Version)
21		cmd := agentcli.MountCLI(
22			agentcli.WithStdin(os.Stdin),
23			agentcli.WithStdout(os.Stdout),
24			agentcli.WithStderr(os.Stderr),
25			agentcli.WithVersion(version, BuildTime, GitCommit),
26		)
27		args := os.Args[1:]
28		if agentcli.NeedsLegacyPassthrough(args) {
29			args = append([]string{"--"}, args...)
30		}
31		cmd.SetArgs(args)
32		if err := cmd.Execute(); err != nil {
33			if code, ok := agentcli.ExitCode(err); ok {
34				os.Exit(code)
35			}
36			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
37			os.Exit(1)
38		}
39	}
40	
41	func effectiveVersion(defaultVersion string) string {
42		if defaultVersion != "" && defaultVersion != "dev" {
43			return defaultVersion
44		}
45		info, ok := debug.ReadBuildInfo()
46		if !ok {
47			return defaultVersion
48		}
49		if info.Main.Version == "" || info.Main.Version == "(devel)" {
50			return defaultVersion
51		}
52		return info.Main.Version
53	}
